WHO WE ARE

Engineering Precision
That Drives Industry

Carbix India Pvt Ltd is a premier distributor and solutions provider for high-performance cutting tools, serving India's most demanding manufacturing sectors from Navi Mumbai.

We deliver advanced tooling solutions across turning, milling, drilling, threading, grooving, CBN and special boring — backed by deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships.
